subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

He made me think of an old time magician more than anything, and I felt that with a touch of his wand he could __**transform**__ us all.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Stagnate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"transform"** means to make a thorough or dramatic change in the form, appearance, or character of something. (परिवर्तन करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The caterpillar will transform into a butterfly.
 
 
 
• **"Stagnate" **means to cease to flow or move; to become inactive or dull. (स्थिर हो जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **Without new investments, the economy will stagnate.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'transform' **is **'stagnate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Stagnate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Alter **(बदलना): To change or make different.

 
 
• **Example:** She had to alter her dress for the wedding.
 
 
 
• **Commute **(आना-जाना): To travel some distance between one's home and place of work on a regular basis.
 
 
• **Example: **He commutes to work by train every day.
 
 
 
• **Convert** (परिवर्तित करना): To change the form, character, or function of something.
 
 
• **Example:** They converted the old barn into a house.
